biggest_catch: Nextdoor never touches your money — there's no checkout, no payout system, and no seller protection. Cash in person or nothing.
catches: No payment processing — you arrange cash/Venmo/Zelle with the buyer yourself.
Nextdoor's official For Sale & Free pages list no seller fees: 'Verified buyers and sellers... All listings are local'; Nextdoor monetizes via ads and business products instead.
Buyers are verified neighbors, which cuts scam risk vs. anonymous classifieds but doesn't eliminate it.
Audience is your neighborhood — great for furniture and bulky goods, poor for niche items.
You must verify your home address to use the platform.

maximize: Nextdoor is the highest-trust local selling venue for furniture, kids' gear, and household goods — verified neighbors, porch pickups, zero fees. Post with clear photos and pickup instructions; price fairly since your audience is literally your neighbors. Use the Free section to clear items fast when the time cost of selling exceeds the item's value. Combine with garage-sale announcements for one-day bulk clearing. Always take cash in person — there is no dispute system if a payment app transfer gets reversed.

s6.note: 5 steps: verify address, post, get messaged, meet/pickup, take cash.

steps: Verify your neighborhood address on Nextdoor
Post your item in For Sale & Free with photos and price (free)
Neighbors message you through the app
Arrange porch pickup or a nearby meetup
Accept cash (or your chosen payment) — no platform fee is deducted
who_pays: The buyer pays you directly — cash, Venmo, or Zelle, arranged between you. Nextdoor processes no payments.
who_qualifies: Anyone with a verified neighborhood address.
work_available: Nextdoor's For Sale & Free section is active — official pages list no seller fees (Nextdoor monetizes via ads and business products instead).
what_gets_accepted: Legal items are accepted; buyers are verified neighbors, which cuts scam risk versus anonymous classifieds but doesn't eliminate it. Best for furniture and bulky goods — niche items sell poorly to a neighborhood-only audience.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No documented listing or selling fees. Unpaid time goes to photos, listing, messaging neighbors, and the pickup itself.
when_cash_arrives: Immediately — cash or your own arranged payment at pickup. There is no platform payout.
